caption: An airliner flying through a storm cloud is hit by lightning, and a flash runs along its wing before the plane flies on.

sa.check: An airliner flies through or beside a storm cloud.
A flash runs along its wing.
The flash is on the wing, not on the tail or nose alone.
The order is flying, flash, flying on.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: it appears on the wing and is gone, and the wing returns to its unlit look; the plane carries on.
pc.fail: The flash stays on the wing as a steady glow for the rest of the clip; or the wing keeps glowing after the bolt is gone; or the flash moves slowly along the wing like a light being drawn; or the flash returns to the same spot and lingers.

pc.expect: The plane is the same before and after the strike: the same fuselage, wings, engines and tail, none appearing or vanishing.
pc.fail: A wing or engine vanishes or duplicates; or the plane changes into a different aircraft; or a second plane appears at the flash; or part of the plane detaches and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The plane keeps its heading and steady motion through the strike; the flash does not push it off course.
pc.fail: The plane stops in mid-air at the flash; or jumps to a new position between dark and lit frames; or reverses direction; or is knocked sideways at the instant of the flash.

pc.expect: The bolt, where seen, is a jagged bright line meeting the plane at a point; the plane keeps its rigid shape.
pc.fail: The bolt is a straight beam or a smooth curve; or a wide glowing tube; or the wing bends or ripples at the strike; or the bolt wraps around the fuselage as a ring.

pc.expect: The plane stays a solid body: the bolt meets its surface and does not pass through the cabin; nothing passes into or through the plane.
pc.fail: The bolt passes through the fuselage and out the other side; or the cabin lights up from within as if the bolt were inside it; or the plane passes through a solid object; or the plane melts or splits apart.

pc.expect: The plane's livery and the cloud's colour stay the same apart from the flash.
pc.fail: The livery changes colour or markings; or the cloud changes colour permanently; or the plane's windows change pattern.
